selectionNote: Selected 15 guided Arches National Park products from attraction catalog d5600-a16091 with live commercial fields and product-specific heroes. Catalog advertises ~90 tours; many are audio/self-guided apps, Moab-already-bound SKUs, inactive/thin commercial listings, or non-Arches Moab adventures. No wine tours found. Jeep/off-road, private hiking, photography/stargazing-adjacent night photo, helicopter, and airplane covered. Paragon reference 265766P10 remains Zion-bound. Moab-bound Arches SKUs (7016P4, 22803P33, 6896MOABAPARK, 458439P2, 334588P4, 18497P15, 169760P14, 265766P59) were not reassigned. Fewer than 20 because viable unbound guided inventory after rejects is 15.
